3_targetTrendTechWorkflow.journey: USER → SEARCH / CATEGORY → PRODUCT → EXACT PRODUCT IDENTITY → VARIANT → MARKETPLACE OFFERS → CURRENT PRICE → PRICE HISTORY → AI ANALYSIS → ALTERNATIVES → RANKINGS

4_productDataHierarchy.hierarchy: CATEGORY → PRODUCT → VARIANT → MARKETPLACE PRODUCT → PRICE OBSERVATION
4_productDataHierarchy.schemaEvaluation: Existing MongoDB models (Product, MarketplaceProduct, PriceHistory) fully support this hierarchy. All schemas preserved without breaking changes.

5_productIdentityDesign.matchingRules: Boundary-checked token matching via productMatching.service.js prevents false matches between distinct products.

6_variantStrategy.rule: Variants are represented distinctly under parent model identity without blurring hardware specs or pricing.

7_marketplaceStrategy.amazonAsinStrategy: Extract canonical /dp/ASIN links from direct store URLs; reject non-canonical search links.

8_imageStrategy.rule: 100% exact model product photography mapped via imagePipeline.service.js. Missing/unverified images render graceful "Product image unavailable" UI state via ProductImage.jsx without generic Unsplash stock photos.

9_priceStrategy.rule: Distinguish currentPrice vs reference originalPrice. Display "Best Current Price" when no genuine reference price exists. Zero fake discount multipliers.

10_priceHistoryStrategy.schema: PriceHistory model indexed by marketplaceProduct + timestamp (-1). Live price updates recorded via sync.service.js.

11_aiAnalysisArchitecture.workflow: 7-step sequential progress animation (aiWorkflow.service.js). Algorithmic scoring breakdown across Performance, Features, Build Quality, Ease of Use, Price Value, and Overall Score (0-100) using verified hardware specs.

12_betterOptionsArchitecture.engine: Recommends verified catalog products matching category, use case, and price bracket (productMatching.service.js).

14_dealsArchitecture.rule: Deals derived from true price drop calculation comparing historical average price vs current lowest offer.

15_comparisonArchitecture.matrix: Side-by-side spec & offer comparison matrix for 2-4 selected products with direct seller links.
